series.label: Registered plug-in vehicles · total stock

sources.title: Virginia Clean Cities / Atlas Public Policy · Virginia EV registrations
sources.note: July 2026 download; BEV+PHEV registered stock, not sales or the complete all-fuel fleet. 378 records have no locality; four localities have no source rows. Twenty-two registration dates after the stock label are retained as a documented source anomaly.
sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database Licence 1.0

limitations: The source contains plug-in registered stock, not all vehicles, annual sales or household adoption.
Four localities lack source rows and remain missing; 378 vehicles lack a locality and cannot be mapped.
Per-resident rates use July 2025 population and December 2025 registrations. They are not the plug-in share of the vehicle fleet.
Model metrics preserve exact source labels. A generic SILVERADO label is separate from SILVERADO EV.
Rivers, urban areas and mountains add geographic context. They do not explain why people purchased a vehicle or relocate the county counts.
series.hosted_scope_note: All retained observations for this measure in the named built-in dataset. Native dates, reporting populations and unavailable/source-ineligible values remain unchanged.
